JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Tickets for the Champion
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: The ferry clerk at Lilycove's harbour has been holding something for Hoenn's new Champion. Nobody will say where it leads.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Islands Beyond the Map
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Two tickets, two specks of rock far out to sea that no chart shows. Something old waits on each, and the Lilycove ferry knows the way.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Where the Unown Gather
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: An old tale tells of ruins in Johto where the Unown gather, and of the Pokemon that shaped the world. Somebody who has stood at the Spear Pillar might want to see them.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The Giant in the Ice
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: The writing in the Sealed Chamber speaks of a giant that once towed the land into place, asleep in a frozen temple far to the north. Its three guardians might be the only ones who can wake it.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: A Favour for the Professor
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Professor Oak has been waiting for his Champion to stop by the lab. He has a favour to ask, and it means a long trip south.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The Ball Nobody Can Open
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Professor Ivy promised Professor Oak something from Valencia Island: a strange ball that no one has managed to open.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The GS Ball
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Nobody can open the GS Ball. In Azalea Town, an old craftsman who turns Apricorns into Poke Balls might know what it is.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The Shrine in the Woods
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Kurt thinks the GS Ball belongs at the little shrine in Ilex Forest. The trees there have been very quiet lately.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Echoes in Johto
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Sailors from Johto sing an old song about a tower in the cliffs, where the land and the sea are still remembered. The pair that once fought over Hoenn may have left an echo there.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The Tower in the Cliffs
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Off Route 47 stands a tower older than Johto's oldest stories. Deep inside, something rumbles like the earth, and something answers like the sea.
